scope: Literature grounded process feasibility and explanation; no new electromagnetic runs
key_findings: A3 dimension scale is laser machinable in principle; exact sharp-cornered smooth-wall narrow-bottom dense-array morphology not demonstrated by user equipment
SiO2 is a traceable MIR dielectric benchmark, not a demonstrated unique optimum or mandatory material
510nm sputtered SiO2 n,k do not validate porous sol-gel or particle deposit n,k
2um H100 ideal bottom-fill dry volume 0.418741pL; deposition morphology must be measured
Oblique absorptance is a reciprocal-channel computational route to directional thermal emissivity; outgoing and incoming k have opposite signs
recommended_next_step: Calibrate manufacturable bare TA2 cavities; compare realistic sol-gel coating or localized filling morphology with bare control; update geometry and material optical inputs before wider ML/angle optimization
